-- A manipulating device comprising: a rocker (1), a supporting member (2) a magnetic assembly (3) and a coil assembly (4), wherein the rocker (1) is rotatable around the supporting member (2); the coil assembly (4) is disposed opposite to the rocker (1), the magnetic assembly (-3 is disposed on one end of the rocker (1) adjacent to the coil assembly (1); the magnetic assembly (3) comprising a central magnet (31) and at least one side magnets (32). By providing the magnetic assembly (3) on the one end of the rocker (1) adjacent to the coil assembly (4), the power for rotating the rocker (1) is adjusted by interaction force between the magnetic assembly (3) and the coil assembly (1), and the interaction force between the magnetic assembly (3) and the coil assembly (1) can be further adjusted by adjusting the magnitude of the current of the coil assembly (1), to improvc the manipulation cxpcricncc of the uscr. -- 3
